data.name: Rifaatun
data.gender_notes: Rifaatun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who gives protection and blessings. The name Rifaatun carries the meaning “Protector” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Rifaatun usually hope their child will grow to embody protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a protector and guardian, reminding one of their role to shield and bless others
data.etymology: Rifaatun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rifaatun total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: رفعاتن
in_arabic.long_meaning: رفعاتن هي اسم مؤنث يأتي من الجذر ر ف ع والذي يعني الرفعة والارتقاء في الدرجات، وهو اسم مشتق من الفعل رَفَعَ الذي يعني رفع الشيء أو الشخص إلى أعلى مكان، وهو مصطلح قديم يُستخدم لوصف الشخص الذي يرفع من شأن الإسلام والمسلمين، وله أهمية كبيرة في التراث الإسلامي

in_urdu.name: رفعاتن
in_urdu.long_meaning: رفعاتن ایک عربی نام ہے جو ر ف ع کے gốc سے اخذ کیا گیا ہے جس کا مطلب ہے بلندی اور ترقی، یہ نام رَفَع کے فعل سے مشتق ہے جس کا مطلب ہے کسی چیز یا شخص کو بلند کرنا، یہ نام اسلامی روایت میں بہت اہم ہے اور اسے-Muslim ناموں میں بہت استعمال کیا جاتا ہے

in_hindi.name: रिफ़ातुन
in_hindi.long_meaning: रिफ़ातुन एक अरबी नाम है जो र फ अ के मूल से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है उच्चता और उन्नति, यह नाम र फ अ के क्रिया से निकला है जिसका अर्थ है किसी चीज या व्यक्ति को ऊपर उठाना, यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है और इसका उपयोग मुस्लिम नामों में बहुत किया जाता है

in_pashto.name: رفعاتن
in_pashto.long_meaning: رفعاتن د عربي نوم دی چې د ر ف ع څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې معنی یې لوړوالی او پرمختگ دی، دا نوم د ر ف ع د فعل څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې معنی یې د چيز یا شخص لوړول دي، دا نوم په اسلامي دود کې ډېر مهم دی او د мусلم نومونو په توګه ډېر کارول کیږي

in_english.name: Rifaatun

It is a name that signifies strength, kindness, and generosity, and is often given to children as a symbol of hope and protection.

It is a reminder that even in the midst of challenges and hardships, Allah is always present and providing shelter and guidance. Furthermore, it is a call to be generous and kind to others, extending the same protection and blessings to those around us. Ultimately, the name "Rifaatun" serves as a constant reminder of the love, kindness, and protection of Allah, inspiring us to be the same for others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Rifaatun represents the one who is bestowed with divine protection and shielded from harm. The name embodies the idea of seeking refuge in Allah and trusting Him to safeguard us from trials and tribulations.

historical_references.reference: Rifaat al-Said, an Arab nationalist leader who advocated for Syrian independence from Ottoman rule and later from French mandate. He was one of the founders of the Arab Nationalist Party in 1932 and served as its president until his death in 1958.
